verdicts.reason: In both, the barrel photo has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail, the logo mark is postage-stamp sized, and a stray black bar and a cut-off texture fragment float in large areas of empty white, so the design is gone. A at least keeps these fragments in one cluster near the bottom. B spreads them down the canvas, with uneven gaps and right-aligned tagline that matches nothing, so it reads even more like scattered debris.
